verdict.rationale: Ledgy lets admins create a dedicated API service account per integration (Company Settings → General → API service accounts). Each one authenticates via the OAuth 2.0 client_credentials grant, gets short-lived 24-hour tokens, can be revoked immediately and can have its secret rotated, so an agent can get its own isolated, revocable credential. However, 'scoped per integration' describes credential isolation rather than least-privilege permissions: no docs show choosing scopes, read-only versus write access, or limiting a service account to specific data or operations. Missing for 10: configurable permission scopes or roles for service accounts, per-resource or read-only restriction, independent or hands-on corroboration.
